# Environment variables

Everything lives in one `.env` file at the repo root (git-ignored). `npm run stack:env` creates or completes it with random secrets and never changes an existing value. `docker compose` refuses to start if a required secret is missing. Template: `.env.example`. On the server, the same file sits in the deploy folder (`docs/DEPLOYMENT_VM.md`).

## Secrets (generated by `npm run stack:env`)

| Variable | Used by | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `POSTGRES_USER` / `POSTGRES_PASSWORD` | migrate job only | Postgres superuser (migrations and role setup) |
| `LENS_APP_PASSWORD` / `LENS_WORKER_PASSWORD` | api / worker | Least-privilege database logins (`setup-roles.mjs` applies them on every migrate run) |
| `REDIS_PASSWORD` | api, worker | Redis |
| `GARAGE_RPC_SECRET` / `GARAGE_ADMIN_TOKEN` | garage, storage-init | Storage node secret and admin token |
| `S3_API_ACCESS_KEY_ID` / `S3_API_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY` | api | Storage key: write-only on `statements`, read-only on `exports` |
| `S3_WORKER_ACCESS_KEY_ID` / `S3_WORKER_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY` | worker | Storage key: read/delete on `statements`, write/delete on `exports` |
| `SESSION_SECRET` | api | Signs the `lens_session` cookie (32+ chars) |
| `OTP_PEPPER` | api | HMAC key for sign-in codes (16+ chars) |
| `IP_HASH_SECRET` | api | HMAC key so consent rows hold a hash of the IP, never the IP |
| `FILE_KEK_ID` / `FILE_KEK_<ID>` | api, worker | Key-encryption key for files and exports (64 hex). Rotation: `docs/RUNBOOK.md` (`rewrap-keys.mjs`). Never commit, never change a key while data uses it |
| `TEST_POSTGRES_PASSWORD` / `TEST_REDIS_PASSWORD` | test services only | Throwaway test Postgres/Redis (`infra/compose.test.yml`) |

## Accounts you add (production)

| Variable | Used by | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `APP_URL` | api, web | Public URL, e.g. `https://pnllens.com` (redirects, CSRF origin) |
| `MAIL_DRIVER` / `MAIL_FROM` / `RESEND_API_KEY` | api | Email: `resend` in production (`console` in dev writes `.data/dev-mail.log`) |
| `SMTP_HOST` / `SMTP_PORT` / `SMTP_USER` / `SMTP_PASS` | api | Email with `MAIL_DRIVER=smtp`, e.g. Google Workspace: `smtp.gmail.com`, 465, the mailbox, and a Google **App password** (needs 2-Step Verification; never the account password). `MAIL_FROM` must be that mailbox or a "Send mail as" alias. Gmail allows about 2,000 messages a day per mailbox |
| `DEV_MAIL_DRIVER` | dev stack | `console` (default: codes go to the API's `.data/dev-mail.log`) or `smtp` to send real email from a local stack. The e2e overlay always uses `console` |
| `GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID` / `GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET` | api | Google sign-in (optional; the button hides without them). Redirect URI: `{APP_URL}/api/auth/google/callback` |
| `PAYMENTS_MODE` | api | `off` (default) or `razorpay` (`docs/PAYMENTS_RAZORPAY.md`) |
| `RAZORPAY_KEY_ID` / `RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET` / `RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET` | api | Razorpay (razorpay mode) |
| `PRICING_DEFAULT_COUNTRY` | api, web | Price when the country is unknown (default `US`) |
| `RESTIC_REPOSITORY` / `RESTIC_PASSWORD` / `AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID` / `AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY` | `backup.sh` | Off-site encrypted backups (e.g. DigitalOcean Spaces) |
| `ALERT_EMAIL` | `healthcheck.sh` | Where uptime and disk alerts go |
| `IMAGE_REGISTRY` | `deploy.sh` (prod) | Pull images `<registry>/<svc>:<tag>` built by GitHub Actions, e.g. `ghcr.io/<owner>/pnl-lens`; unset = build on the server |
| `DOMAIN` / `TLS_MODE` | caddy (prod) | Site name; `cloudflare` (origin certificate in `infra/certs/`) or `internal` (self-signed, for the VM test) |

## Settings with defaults

| Variable | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `TZ` | `Asia/Kolkata` (set in images) | Pinned server timezone (D9) |
| `AUTH_MODE` | `jwt` in prod; `dev` in the dev stack | `dev` signs everyone in as the seeded dev user; never in production |
| `WORKER_CONCURRENCY` / `ENGINE_TIMEOUT_MS` / `ENGINE_MEMORY_MB` | `2` / `60000` / `512` | Worker throughput and per-job engine limits |
| `WORKER_MEM_LIMIT` | `2g` | Worker container memory (concurrency × engine memory + ~300 MB; `docs/LOAD_TEST.md`) |
| `OTP_PER_IP_PER_HOUR_OVERRIDE` | — | E2E tests only (`infra/compose.e2e.yml`): raises the sign-in-code limit per IP (default 20 an hour). `compose.prod.yml` never passes it |
| `RATE_LIMIT_EXEMPT_IPS` | — | Load and e2e tests only (`infra/compose.load.yml`, `infra/compose.e2e.yml`: every test browser shares one address): IPs/CIDRs the rate limiter skips. `compose.prod.yml` never passes it |
| `PLAN_REMINDERS` | on | `off` stops the API's check-up reminder sender |
| `PLAN_REMINDER_INTERVAL_MS` / `PLAN_REMINDER_FROM_HOUR` | `600000` / `9` | How often the API looks for due check-up reminders, and the IST hour from which a reminder due today goes out. The e2e overlay uses `2000` / `0` |
| `WEEKLY_DIGEST` | on | `off` stops the API's weekly summary sender |
| `DIGEST_INTERVAL_MS` / `DIGEST_FROM_HOUR` | `900000` / `9` | How often the API looks for weekly summaries to send, and the IST hour on Monday from which they go out. The e2e overlay uses `2000` / `0` |
| `PLAN_FONTS_DIR` | `apps/api/assets/fonts` | Fonts embedded in the 30-day plan PDF (found automatically) |
| `RETENTION_USAGE_MONTHS` / `RETENTION_AUDIT_MONTHS` | `12` / `24` | Log retention (`purge_logs`, LAWYER CHECK) |
| `EXTRA_ALLOWED_ORIGINS` | — | More origins allowed to send state-changing requests |
| `EXPOSE_OPENAPI` | `true` in dev only | Serves `/api/v1/openapi.json` |
| `API_INTERNAL_URL` | `http://api:4000` | Where the web server reaches the api |
| `HTTP_BIND` / `HTTP_PORT` | `127.0.0.1` / `8080` | Dev stack address |
| `TEST_PG_PORT` / `TEST_REDIS_PORT` | `55432` / `56379` | Test services |

Per-service connection strings (`DATABASE_URL`, `REDIS_URL`, `S3_*`) are built by the compose files from the values above.
